source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-15

procedures.title: Window regulator, manual: remove and install
steps: Remove the 2 screws holding the stationary horizontal channel.
Remove the window crank housing (3 screws).
Take out the crank shaft, pin and spring washer.
Remove the 2 regulator screws located next to the spring opening.
Remove the lower bolt holding the front glass channel.
Take the nut off the adjusting stud and move the front channel outward to give room for the regulator.
Fold the regulator linkage out to its elongated position.
Holding the front channel pushed outward, work the regulator forward and rearward and out through the access hole (see figure 36 in the manual).
Lubricate all guide rails and rollers whenever the regulator is apart.
Test the regulator thoroughly before refitting the door trim panel.
Adjust the window (see door window adjustments).

procedures.title: Window regulator, power: remove, disassemble and install
steps: If the window will not work, check the electrical connections first (figure 37 in the manual shows junctions, switches and circuit breaker).
Removal: Unplug the electrical connectors from the motor before doing any work on the regulator.
Do steps 1 through 12 of Window Regulator - Manual removal.
notes: Figure 37 in the manual shows the regulator location on the door and its wiring.
Disassembly caution: do not remove the motor from the regulator until the locking steps that follow are done.
